title: Erdős 269 three-prime running-LCM cells, shell digits, and cofinal residue frontier

concepts.label: restricted two-dimensional floor sum
concepts.note: The exact count of one exponent after fixing the other two, evaluated at arbitrary or pure-power cutoffs without replacing the true smooth prefix by a rectangular approximation.

concepts.label: true smooth shell multiplicity
concepts.note: The cardinality difference between two literal strict three-prime smooth prefixes, including its exact restricted-floor-sum and pure-power endpoint forms.

concepts.label: four-letter dyadic block radix
concepts.note: For the {2,3,5} jump word, the product of the terminal factor 2 and the optional internal 3- and 5-channel jumps in one dyadic block.

concepts.label: exact rank-two kernel obstruction
concepts.note: The nonzero -1/15 minor of the smallest {2,3,5} kernel rectangle, which excludes a rank-one separation of the three exponent coordinates.

concepts.label: division-free affine carry window
concepts.note: The accumulated base and forcing that exactly unroll a variable-radix affine recurrence across a finite local window.

concepts.label: smooth-factor denominator reduction
concepts.note: Absorption of a fixed {2,3,5}-smooth factor into the running height, followed conditionally by cancellation from a carry recurrence whose states share that factor.

concepts.label: cofinal least-positive-residue escape
concepts.note: The denominator-dependent assertion that arbitrarily late local windows have a canonical positive residue above the matching reduced-carry bound.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FINITE NORMAL FORM: for positive first base p, the number of exponent triples with p^i q^j r^k < x is exactly both the sum of the cardinalities of its p-exponent fibres over admissible (q,r) pairs and the literal restricted two-dimensional floor sum built from those fibres.
statement_nodes.engine: finite fibrewise cardinality decomposition followed by an explicit bijection between abstract projection fibres and p-exponent fibres
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is elementary finite counting and is recorded as the exact integer carrier for the paper's block digits; no novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The identity is finite and exact. It is not an asymptotic smooth-number estimate, a convergence theorem, or an irrationality statement.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED PURE-POWER SPECIALISATION: at cutoff p^a with p>1 and positive q,r, each admissible (q,r)-pair contributes exactly a-log_p(q^j r^k) possible p-exponents, so the strict three-prime count is the explicit restricted logarithmic floor sum.
statement_nodes.engine: exact cardinality of a one-dimensional exponent fibre at a pure-power cutoff
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: An elementary exact floor-sum rewrite at a pure-power cutoff; no novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This counts a finite strict prefix. It neither orders the infinite jump series nor estimates its tail.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED TRUE-SHELL FORMULA: for x<=y the number of literal three-prime smooth exponent triples in [x,y) is the difference of the two strict counts, equivalently the difference of their restricted fibre counts or restricted floor sums; between pure-power endpoints p^a<=q^b it is exactly V_q(b)-V_p(a).
statement_nodes.engine: monotonicity of the true strict smooth prefix, finite set difference, and the pure-power floor-sum normal forms
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Finite set subtraction and channel reindexing; recorded because the exact shell multiplicity is the forcing digit used by the window experiment.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The shell is the actual filtered set, but the formula remains finite. No cofinal distribution or anti-concentration of the resulting digits is proved.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CELL-INCREMENT LAW: for p,q,r>1, the increment V_p(a+1)-V_p(a) of the restricted logarithmic floor sum is exactly the number of admissible (q,r)-pairs below p^(a+1).
statement_nodes.engine: decomposition of consecutive pure-power cells into old pairs, each gaining one exponent, and newly admitted pairs, each contributing one
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary discrete differentiation of a finite floor sum; no novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This computes one exact cell increment. It does not supply residue escape, randomness, or any asymptotic law for the digit word.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED EXACT ALPHABET: in every open dyadic block (2^a,2^(a+1)) there is at most one internal power from each of the 3- and 5-channels; therefore the {2,3,5} block radix is exactly one of 2, 6, 10, or 30, and in particular lies between 2 and 30.
statement_nodes.engine: strict multiplicative width two prevents two distinct powers of a base at least two inside one block, leaving two independent channel-presence bits
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The result is an exact paper-specific compression of the {2,3,5} jump word. No claim of novelty or priority is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The alphabet determines the block bases only. It does not identify the actual series carry, control the block digits, or prove cofinal residue escape.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FINITE RANK CERTIFICATE: on exponent coordinates (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1) with third exponent zero, the {2,3,5} reciprocal running-LCM kernel has determinant exactly -1/15; hence this restriction has rank two and the kernel cannot factor as f(i)g(j)h(k).
statement_nodes.engine: exact rational evaluation of the four kernel entries, including H(6)=60 rather than 6
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A finite exact determinant calculation. It strengthens the earlier non-rank-one witness to the paper's explicit -1/15 certificate without making a novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: One nonzero 2x2 minor rules out rank one only. It proves no larger rank bound, analytic independence, irrationality, or transcendence.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED WINDOW NORMAL FORM: every integer affine recurrence A(n+1)=b(n)A(n)+e(n) unrolls across a finite window as A(lo+len)=W(lo,len)A(lo)+F(lo,len), where W is the accumulated product and F the recursively weighted forcing; multiplying every forcing digit by a constant multiplies F by the same constant.
statement_nodes.engine: induction on the finite window length
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Standard affine-recurrence algebra, formalised because it is the exact division-free consumer interface.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem accepts arbitrary radix and forcing words. It neither derives them from the Erdős series nor supplies an escaping window.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED SUMMATION-BY-PARTS FORM: when the forcing digit is the difference V(n+1)-V(n), its accumulated window forcing equals the terminal potential minus the accumulated base times the initial potential plus the exact weighted interior correction.
statement_nodes.engine: induction matching the recursive window forcing with the discrete potential difference
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A standard finite summation-by-parts identity in the paper's variable-radix coordinates.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The identity exposes the forcing exactly but gives no sign, magnitude, or modular anti-concentration estimate for it.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CARRY NORMAL FORM: if c(n+1)=b(n)c(n)-B m(n), then c(lo+len)=W(lo,len)c(lo)-B F(lo,len); when m is a potential difference this has the corresponding exact weighted-potential expansion.
statement_nodes.engine: specialisation of the affine window identity after factoring the constant denominator multiplier from the forcing
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Standard finite recurrence algebra; it is the exact checked consumer used by the residue argument.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem assumes the recurrence. The unproved problem-specific bridge must still show that the actual three-prime series produces such a carry and these digits.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED ABSORPTION: for bases p,q,r>1, every fixed smooth value p^i q^j r^k divides the three-prime running height once the cutoff x reaches that smooth value.
statement_nodes.engine: each exponent is bounded by the corresponding integer logarithm at the cutoff, so the three powers divide coordinatewise
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary divisibility after the running-height product formula; no novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Height divisibility does not imply that a denominator-cleared carry state shares the same factor.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONDITIONAL REDUCTION: if every integral carry state c(n) has the form S d(n) for one nonzero smooth factor S, then S cancels from c(n+1)=b(n)c(n)-S B m(n); when S is positive, positivity and the sharp bound descend to d, and d inherits the exact local-window identity with reduced denominator B.
open_antecedents: the problem-specific rationality-to-carry identification, including proof that every actual denominator-cleared carry state is divisible by the absorbed {2,3,5}-smooth denominator factor
statement_nodes.engine: cancellation in the integer recurrence, order transfer through a positive common factor, and the exact integral-carry window identity
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary cancellation and order arithmetic. The mathematical boundary is the missing divisibility of the actual carry, not the algebra once it is assumed.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem never proves that the actual carry shares S. Therefore it does not by itself reduce an arbitrary hypothetical rational denominator to a factor coprime with 30.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED FINITE CONSUMER: for positive modulus C, the canonical least positive representative of x modulo C lies in {1,...,C} and is congruent to x; hence no positive integer state with absolute value at most K can be congruent to x when that representative is strictly larger than K.
statement_nodes.engine: canonical Euclidean remainder with the zero class represented by C, followed by the two finite residue cases
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary modular arithmetic. The explicit zero-residue convention prevents an invalid absolute-value replacement.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This theorem consumes one escaping residue. It gives no reason that such a residue exists for the actual radix/digit word.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED CONDITIONAL EXTINCTION: if the denominator-dependent CofinalLocalWindowEscape predicate holds for radix b, digit word m, and bound K, then for every positive B coprime to 30 there is no everywhere-positive integer sequence d satisfying d(n+1)=b(n)d(n)-B m(n) and |d(n)|<=K(B,n).
open_antecedents: CofinalLocalWindowEscape for the actual {2,3,5} dyadic radix, exact shell-multiplicity digits, and denominator-dependent carry bound
statement_nodes.engine: choose one escaping window, reduce the exact carry window identity modulo its accumulated base, and apply the canonical least-positive-residue contradiction
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The finite consumer is elementary; no novelty or priority claim is made for the conditional packaging.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: CofinalLocalWindowEscape is a named Prop supplied as a hypothesis, not a proved theorem. The result also assumes the reduced carry recurrence and does not connect it to the original series.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: EXACT COMPUTATIONAL EVIDENCE WITH A HARD CEILING: the integer-only checker reproduces the three displayed certificates and, for all 106666 pairs with B<=1000, gcd(B,30)=1, and 100<=a<=500, finds an escaping window of length at most 18 (largest first-success length 14); these bounded quantifiers do not establish CofinalLocalWindowEscape for unbounded B or arbitrarily late starts.
open_antecedents: a proof uniform in every positive B coprime to 30
escape after every requested starting index rather than only 100<=a<=500
the rationality-to-actual-carry identification and smooth-factor divisibility
statement_nodes.engine: scripts/check_erdos269_dyadic_windows.py with --max-denominator 1000 --start-min 100 --start-max 500 --max-length 18 --assert-packet; exact integer output schema erdos269-dyadic-window-exact-check/1
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is reproducible project computation, not a Lean theorem, literature claim, or novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The barrier rejects only the inference from a bounded successful scan to a cofinal theorem. It does not refute CofinalLocalWindowEscape and it does not weaken any individual finite certificate.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The pure-power theorem evaluates the same exact fibre decomposition at x=p^a and closes each one-dimensional fibre by an integer logarithm.
A true shell is the set difference of two strict prefixes, so its cardinality is the difference of the two exact count normal forms.
At pure-power endpoints the two strict prefix counts become the explicit logarithmic floor sums V_q(b) and V_p(a).
The discrete derivative identifies the exact change between consecutive pure-power floor-sum cells rather than merely re-evaluating each endpoint independently.
The potential identity is the affine window forcing specialised to a discrete-difference digit word.
The carry identity is the affine recurrence normal form with forcing e(n)=-B m(n).
When the exact shell digit is a difference of smooth-count potentials, the carry window consumes the summation-by-parts forcing formula directly.
Height absorption supplies the intended smooth factor, but the cancellation theorem additionally needs the unproved fact that every actual carry state is divisible by it.
After cancelling the common smooth factor, the reduced carry inherits the same exact window identity with multiplier B.
The conditional extinction theorem reduces one selected cofinal escape window to a congruence using the exact carry-window identity.
At the endpoint of the selected window, the cofinal predicate supplies exactly the residue-above-bound hypothesis consumed by the finite modular contradiction.
The denominator reduction and the cofinal window producer are the two independent missing bridges needed before the finite reduced-carry contradiction can address the actual series.
The checker constructs every tested block base from the exact four-letter {2,6,10,30} radix alphabet.
Its block digits are computed from exact differences of strict smooth-count potentials, the executable counterpart of the true-shell formula.
Success on 106666 bounded denominator/start pairs does not meet the consumer's universal denominator and arbitrarily-late-start quantifiers.
